name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A structured playbook that makes an AI coding assistant behave like a disciplined engineer — asking clarifying questions, planning before coding, and working autonomously for hours without going off the rails.
buyer: An engineering lead at a small software company who has developers using AI coding agents but is frustrated by agents that code first and ask questions never, producing messy, unreviewed work.
business_use_cases: A dev agency standardizes every project's AI agent workflow on this methodology so junior engineers get consistent, spec-then-code discipline out of their tools.
A solo founder building a product lets the agent run 'subagent-driven development' overnight on a well-scoped feature and reviews a clean, tested diff in the morning.
N/A as a third case — the value here is process discipline for existing dev teams, not a new customer-facing product.

money_ideas.idea: The project already sells commercial/enterprise support and managed spending for teams adopting this methodology at scale.
Offer paid workshops teaching engineering teams how to adopt subagent-driven development using this framework.

steal_this: Not much to build — it's a methodology and plugin, not a product gap; the fastest move is installing it and adapting the workflow to your own team's process.
